study type: Methodology study (Systematic review and modified-Delphi consensus process for developing a Core Outcome Set)
outcome: Admission to intensive care unit/special units (maternal)
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit/special units
cohort: The study participants were 150 international stakeholders and 24 representatives involved in online surveys and consensus meetings, with diverse professional backgrounds, gender, and geographical representation.
finding: A comprehensive core outcome set (COS) for maternal and neonatal health research and surveillance during emerging and ongoing epidemic threats was developed, including seven main and seven complementary maternal outcomes, and eleven main and four complementary neonatal outcomes, along with agreed-upon definitions.
mod_finding: N/A (Mode of birth was identified as an important maternal outcome to track, but the study itself did not generate findings related to it).
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight is an outcome identified in the COS, not a characteristic of the study participants)
gest_age: N/A (preterm delivery and prematurity are outcomes identified in the COS, not characteristics of the study participants)
